document_title: Uttar Pradesh Fire Prevention and Fire Safety Act, 2005 & National Building Code 2016
disclaimer: DEMO / SYNTHETIC — NOT OFFICIAL REGULATORY TEXT (Curated for SIH 2026 Prototype)

sections.title: Provision of fire prevention and fire safety measures
sections.text: Every occupier of an industrial or commercial building exceeding statutory height or built-up area thresholds, or storing hazardous/combustible substances, must provide and maintain mandatory fire fighting equipment, automatic sprinklers, smoke alarms, fire hydrants, and unhindered emergency evacuation passages as specified under Part IV of NBC 2016.

sections.title: Inspection of premises and grant of Provisional / Final Fire NOC
sections.text: Before initiating construction, an enterprise must secure a Provisional Fire NOC by submitting certified architectural layout blueprints. Upon completion of building construction and installation of fire-fighting mechanisms, the Chief Fire Officer (CFO) conducts on-site physical verification before issuing the Final Fire Safety NOC.
